notes.title: It’s Chessarama Anniversary 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/351c8a90d4deda014a1b0848facdbeb02e769f1a.png[/img]

Do you remember what you were doing a year ago? We do: we were releasing [b]Chessarama[/b]!

Today marks Chessarama’s anniversary, and we’re happy to have spent this year with you. Thank you for being part of our community 💙

[h2]What happened this year?[/h2]

Even after the release, we didn’t stop working on our game! Just last week, we updated [b]Chess Match[/b], one of the three game modes in Chessarama.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/434684fbda49d3a4732c8abea5f2b2fad4411012.png[/img]

We introduced a “same set” button, that makes your opponent uses the same chess set as yours, and added more time control options to play your matches.

But the real highlight of these features is the addition of new themed chessboards:

[list]
[*] [b]Farmer Board
[*] Soccer Board
[*] Samurai Board
[*] Dragon Board[/b][/list]
Our art team designed these chessboards inspired by the Campaign games, so you can pair your chess set with matching boards! ♟️

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1831830/view/4465977636998349047]Check out all the new features here![/url]

[h2]Time to celebrate with a gift[/h2]

Since we’re in an anniversary mood, why not surprise your friends? 🎁

Gift the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36608/Chessarama_Grandmaster_Edition_BUY_AS_A_GIFT/]Chessarama Grandmaster Edition[/url][/b] to your friends who loves chess, puzzles, and strategy! We would love this a gift for us, too 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36608/Chessarama_Grandmaster_Edition_BUY_AS_A_GIFT/

[b]Thank you for an amazing year as part of our community. 2025 will bring even more exciting updates to Chessarama, so stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Chess Match Improvements! ♟️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/acecd9fafffbfae74403595217e45ce844a849c1.png[/img]

Howdy, everyone!

If you read our last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1831830/view/4541409756166750487]Patch Notes[/url], you're aware that we made some updates on the [b]Chess Match[/b] mode! ♟️

[h2]What's new?[/h2]

We heard you, and we're happy to present the new features available on Chess Match:

[h3]Same set option[/h3]

The opponent set could be any set available on Chessarama, which means that could be different from the one you select.
Now, if you want both chess sets to be the same, you can toggle the option "[i]same set as opponent[/i]"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/42dc323f0eeb88a2845a5c91ee963a9b32a762c9.png[/img]

[h3]Time control[/h3]

The time for each match had a default of 5 minutes only. Now, you have more options based on what's better and more comfortable for you to play:

[list]
[*] [b]2 min + 1s[/b] (2 minutes to finish the match + 1 second increment per move)
[*] [b]5 min + 5s[/b] (5 minutes to finish the match + 5 seconds increment per move)
[*] [b]10 min + 0s[/b] (10 minutes to finish the match + no increment per move)
[*] [b]15 min + 15s[/b] (15 minutes to finish the match + 15 seconds increment per move)
[/list]
Whenever you open Chess Match, the default time will be [b]5 min + 5s[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/cdcfa1557cdb17a23ba37f542cb61849d4362926.png[/img]

[h2]There's more![/h2]

We also made [b]new themed boards[/b] that you can use on your matches!
Now you have five board options:

[list]
[*] [b]Default Board[/b]
[*] [b]Farmer Board[/b] (unlocked after 5800 XP)
[*] [b]Soccer Board[/b] (unlocked after  8400 XP)
[*] [b]Samurai Board[/b] (unlocked after 10400 XP)
[*] [b]Dragon Board[/b] (unlocked after 16000 XP)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/60713f998e1d91b9b1f077f378312bb7cf4a0c04.png[/img]
[b]
That's all the incredible updates on the Chess Match mode! Which one did you like the most? ♟️[/b]

notes.title: 🔨 Patch Notes & data issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/9b92f6c5f0475151deba4c2d161074cb7f79ab68.png[/img]

Howdy, Chessarama fans!

Today we are publishing a new build, with some important updates and fixes. Let's first list all fixes and then discuss the issue we had with data persistence and how it impacted our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/f8925691e397ceb16d13150b110100b4aadaa66d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Live Challenges achievements are now properly triggering;
[*] The term "Live Challenges" is properly translated in-game to other languages;
[*] The "[i]Win without moving your pieces into a Fenced tile[/i]" challenge was changed in Knight Supreme to make it more persistent;
[*] Fixed an error in data persistence (more below).
[/list]
[h1]The issue with data persistence[/h1]

As a few players noted, the last update had the undesired side effect of making previously completed Challenges to become uncompleted. Our team worked hard in the last few days to understand what happened as well as to implement a more robust solution going forward.

[b]Here is a summary of the issue:[/b]

We use Playfab as our tool to manage the "live" part of the game, such as the Leaderboards, XPs, Live Challenges, etc. We identified an unexpected bug in how the game communicates with Playfab, which resulted in some lost progress data (more on that below).

[b]What are the consequences?[/b]
[list]
[*] Every player lost their "challenges" progress (but not the XP associated with it);
[*] No player lost their XP - this data is solid and correct;
[*] No player lost Steam Achievements;
[*] No player lost level progression;
[*] No other consequence was identified.
[/list]
[b]Here is what you can expect from the current build (v1.1.3) onward:[/b]
[list]
[*] After a lot of revisions, tests, and dedication from our team, we identified the bug and corrected it. Everything should work as expected now regarding the challenges, XP, and general player progress;
[*] However, as explained above, all players lost their "Challenge" progression (but didn't lose the XP associated with it);
[*] If you decide to re-do those challenges, you will earn more XP - so in some sense, this is a "good" side-effect (and unavoidable consequence) of the issue.
[/list]
So, this is the current state of the game and the bug has been fixed. We are reviewing our workflow and QA to ensure problems like this will not happen again in the future. Making games is a complex thing, but better processes can always help 🙂

We appreciate all the support you have been giving to us! Your patience and feedback have been fundamental for us to keep improving the game.

Please keep reporting bugs or suggesting improvements in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1831830/discussions/?snr=1_5_9_][b]Community Hub[/b][/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/CWDbyK7rV5][b]Discord server[/b][/url], as we are daily following the forums and using your feedback to improve Chessarama.

Many thanks for your support!

notes.title: A Ronin's vision — How the dioramas in Lady Ronin are produced?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/efe484d1f38a8c2d60a565141abf45981efc9cb6.png[/img]

In their ongoing quest to refine Chessarama, the next target of our Art Team was the dioramas in Lady Ronin! ⚔️

Lady Ronin is one of the games from Campaign Mode. It’s designed to immerse players in a world inspired by feudal Japan. In this epic journey, our protagonist is a legendary Ronin on a mission to destroy an evil and unfair Shogun.

Keep reading today’s [b]Checkmate Chronicles[/b] to discover the secrets behind the creation of Lady Ronin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/7adbfe7f39ad978c3ad0b9810322660bca44d926.gif[/img]

[h2]Setting the scene: illuminating the world of Lady Ronin[/h2]

Our dioramas are deeply inspired by the Japanese culture. To kickstart this exciting transformation, our Art Team embarked on an illuminating endeavor to harmonize the visuals, crafting an immersive experience that perfectly captures the essence of Lady Ronin's world.

Some features we introduced were captivating god rays to our morning scenes, and enchanting particles to our night scenes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/b818a397fa3c46f6cb495368aefd2333328c669b.png[/img]

[h2]Cherry blossom dreams: reimagining the landscape[/h2]

As we worked to enhance the atmosphere of the game, we found inspiration in nature itself. While previously Lady Ronin's trees traditionally sported an orange palette, we recognized the need to align with the serene beauty of Japanese cherry blossoms! 🌸

Our Art Team undertook the task of transforming the tree color palette to capture the essence of these delicate blooms:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/028a7577dd3249fc817a45eb6821e4b37deae107.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting Lady Ronin's World[/h2]

At Chessarama, not only biggest changes are made; our meticulous Art Team is equally dedicated to refining each level.

Consider, for instance, our approach to water shading. By introducing a more "stylized" touch, we've transformed the visual aesthetic, ensuring a harmonious fit within the game's world! 🌊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/481318934b655965b25bd987613ef1338b2ac869.png[/img]

But we didn't stop there; the magic of Chessarama often lies in the subtleties. Our night levels, too, received an artful upgrade. Beyond the addition of particles, we took care to populate these levels with additional assets. In levels that are missing a verdant life, we introduced lush vegetation, enriching the surroundings. In others, a delicate touch of blue fog now shrouds the water, evoking an alluring ambiance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/f8fd585c703f7c63f95a692ba2b912d3efcff0ff.png[/img]

It's our attention to detail that enchants Chessarama. In the end, the metamorphosis of Lady Ronin's dioramas serves as a testament to our commitment to delivering an authentic and captivating experience for our players. 💙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/ad3b4a31a73209f29a8a1870555727d284678748.gif[/img]

Stay tuned as we continue to infuse life and culture into the world of Chessarama!

[b]And don't forget to add Chessarama to your Wishlist:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/

We'd also love to hear from you: [b]what would you like to know more about Chessarama for the next chapter of Checkmate Chronicles?[/b] Write in the comments below!

See you soon! ♟️

notes.title: Chessarama redesigned: a peek into our new interface 🎨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/b9a8365116cb5b159cbbff8a7300d17a4c486076.png[/img]

Welcome back to [b]Checkmate Chronicles[/b], where we unveil the intriguing transformation tales behind the development of Chessarama!

For this chapter, we're shining the spotlight on a critical aspect of any game — the [b]User Interface (UI)[/b]. Strap in, as we journey from the wireframes of the past to our vibrant new designs. Ready to experience this visual transformation? 🖌️

[h2]Exploring the art of usability[/h2]

The UI in a game acts as the gateway to its essence. When well-executed, it weaves effortlessly into gameplay, enhancing immersion and user experience. 
Our team embarked on a mission to redesign Chessarama’s entire UI, aiming for an interface that wasn’t just visually appealing, but also sparkled with joy and improved usability.

The UI's new version boasts a cohesive design, with recurring components that create a stronger visual identity. By maintaining consistency, we've ensured that interactive elements are instantly recognizable, thus elevating the overall user experience.

[h2]A deep dive into the new designs[/h2]

[b]Main Menu:[/b] With the game title taking its rightful place and the repositioned buttons aligned to the left, our main menu promises enhanced readability, providing the perfect gateway to our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/972ddef7399396c0f91d0c9d4c57118722bcba6f.png[/img]

[b]Campaign Level Select:[/b] The improvements include a clearer indication of the status of the levels (locked, completed, all challenges made), a better contrast between text and background, and a more intuitive pagination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/0386619e4f30ecb32fbf4452054a079d3f130751.png[/img]

[b]Set Selection — Chess Match:[/b] On the new version, players can instantly see all sets available to select and easily identify that “Play a Match” is a button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/3ad05e88fcaf4a9d7ba8951c23fdab70d028ddf6.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay — Campaign:[/b] On-screen displays now keep players informed about the current game mode and level. The “Close” button also features a more user-friendly text. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/3084f53a779edc0b50905f2cbba675df2807b0fe.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay — Battles:[/b] Enhanced button visibility, improved contrast, and a more user-friendly input indication system form the core of this overhaul. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/e6d45937a07d00bd77b2c3df01f932d32ee40ad4.png[/img]

[b]Results — Battles:[/b] Now there’s a differentiation between challenges that were completed previously and on the current run. Badges mark level/match completion and all challenges completion. And it is clear which chess set will be received for completing all challenges of each Battle mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/302b253216c7871f0cf09ad8d517100774ad8879.png[/img]

[b]Pause Menu:[/b] The revamped pause menu is more clean, with game stats removed from it (since it is now available on the Level Select when accessed via gameplay) for improved clarity and user flow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/2498682f205e65a46b7aba38978a68f3b7a84940.png[/img]

[b]Profile:[/b] The new profile shows the player progress and stats in a more joyful way on the new layout, with more images and the information better grouped and organized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/169160f1037edf842fa87deef6fa9b8a90b4fca2.png[/img]

[b]Collection:[/b] The Collection has been refined, featuring grayscale for locked items, clear unlock conditions, and an expanded set view within the same screen for effortless navigation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/c9f7da904dbc71d94cf1ba693aeeb2e2e4b9e295.png[/img]

[h2]An interface transformed[/h2]

Our UI redesign didn't merely focus on aesthetic touch-ups. Every screen underwent a transformation, raising the quality and consistency bar. Addressing previously identified usability issues, we've strived to make your Chessarama journey smoother and more delightful!

As always, we cherish the support and enthusiasm from our community. Feel free to drop your thoughts and suggestions in the comments. And if you haven't already, [b]remember to add Chessarama to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/

Until our next chronicle, keep strategizing and enjoy the revamped experience! 💙

See you soon on the board. ♟️

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/c1e71761d8ecd3e0ad6828b39289049841f32a7e.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

During May, we have lots of updates and bug fixes in Chessarama's Alpha!

Check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/4823550e924fa44e6124c9d1af2bbe34f7b8e2b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/22a422a7aa74e78fa07ac4adf2ff8a59f59e050e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Progression is now being carried out when accessing Chessarama on other PCs.
[*] Notifications: Pieces unlocked in Campaigns, new games unlocked, and completed Chess sets are being notified.
[*] Gameplay Challenge tab now begins opened and persists if you close/reopen it.
[*] Lady Ronin pronouns were adjusted!
[*] You can now adjust camera rotation sensibility in Settings.
[*] Pieces are now being selected when clicking on the focused tile.
[*] Updated in-game visuals of Soccer Bishop and Soccer King.
[*] Colors were standardized in Battles and Chess Matches: you will always be blue 🟦  and your opponent will always be red 🟥.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/256406fea8e1f8b19a1ae2a4bad020064d32eb8e.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/f8925691e397ceb16d13150b110100b4aadaa66d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Camera Shake toggle is now working as intended.
[*] "ESC" button is working as we expect how it should work (opening/closing menus, canceling modals, etc).
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck on Dragon Slayers game over animation.
[*] Fixed Leaderboard and Codex to work properly on 21:9 resolutions.
[*] Fixed a bug where game settings were not being automatically saved.
[*] A lot of data and processing optimizations were made.
[*] A lot of quality-of-life changes were made.
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes your name and XP was not being correctly displayed in Battles and Chess Matches.
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes, Battles Challenges from a game were completed playing another Battles game.
[*] Fixed a localization issue on the Battles difficulty selector.
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking "play again" would take you to the next level in Campaign games.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/2debf6a5e1ec6d4c672d7c8137c32da68c1670b2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Sometimes you won't get the bonus XP by completing all Challenges of a Battles game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/4823550e924fa44e6124c9d1af2bbe34f7b8e2b9.png[/img]

🎮 [b]You can update your game to the [u]0.9.4 version[/u] on Steam![/b]

🐞 Remember to use the [b]Bug Report[/b] in-game to report bugs, and the [url=https://forms.gle/FxJsMTrEwP3oENVh8][b]Feedback Form[/b][/url] to tell us your opinion (you can access it by clicking the "chat balloons" icon on the left higher corner of the Main Menu).

notes.title: Patch Notes - March 🔨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/faaa58dfa465cd9159318068c116afd690c08244.png[/img]

Hello guys!
With Chessarama's Alphatest version releases, we're working hard to update the game with bug fixes and new content, improving Chessarama for its release in 2023 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/4823550e924fa44e6124c9d1af2bbe34f7b8e2b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/22a422a7aa74e78fa07ac4adf2ff8a59f59e050e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New Campaign game: Street Soccer![/b]
[*] Soccer Chess unlock conditions adjustment.
[*] Soccer Rook unlock conditions adjustment.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/d08c4b373eb76e4f01bd51fdefb35112fa1a209d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/f8925691e397ceb16d13150b110100b4aadaa66d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] V-sync and brightness affect the gameplay as they should.
[*] The "Play Tutorial" button inside the Codex works as intended.
[*] Fixed the "Wishlist" button positioning in Main Menu.
[*] Some English texts from Farm Life Codex text have been revised.
[*] Fixed counters in the "Complete in X moves" Challenges.
[*] Fixed crash after clicking on "Play again" button in Lady Ronin.
[*] Completing a level and clicking the "Main Menu" button now works as intended.
[*] Fixed opponent check counter in Chess Match.
[*] Level Complete stat tracker was removed from Profile to avoid issues.
[*] Fixed Dragon attacks causing permanent black stripes on UI.
[*] Fixed coordinates being disabled when pressing "G" while writing bug reports.
[*] Fixed lagging when choosing Soccer Set in Chess Matches.
[*] Fixed tips staying over UI elements like the Pause Menu.
[*] Fixed the "Main Menu" button on Chess Match.
[*] Fixed opponent without skin when replaying Chess Match.
[*] Fixed localization text in Portuguese (BR) going off the screen in some tips.
[*] Samurai King was optimized in Battles and Chess Matches.
[*] Samurai Queen was optimized in Battles and Chess Matches.
[*] Fixed the Dragon Slayer Challenge "No piece eliminated" triggering when a piece was eliminated.
[*] Fixed the "Main Menu" button at Battles to work as intended.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/2debf6a5e1ec6d4c672d7c8137c32da68c1670b2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Brightness is not affecting the UI as it should.
[*] Some Knights don't have their disappear animation working as intended in Farm Life.
[*] Lack of white movement highlight when mouse hovering tiles in Street Soccer.
[*] Some Knights don't have their base disappearing after the level is complete in Farm Life.
[*] When choosing another language, some terms in Challenges may carry over from the past language.
[/list]

notes.title: FAQ — Chessarama
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41593786/38e3916beab01d815a1a0c1657c97c65ee4d0710.png[/img]

Do you have interest on Chessarama, but have some questions about it?

We prepared a FAQ to help you understand more about our game! 😊


[h2]First of all, what's Chessarama?[/h2]

Chessarama is a premium collection of [i]original chess-inspired puzzle games.[/i]
It features dozens of exclusive Chess Figures, hundreds of hand-crafted levels and a Creative Mode. You'll be able to create and share your own puzzles with the whole community!

Chessarama reimagines chess rules and mechanics using many different themes. Each game has its own theme, set of rules and original hand-crafted levels.


[h2]When the game will be released?[/h2]

We're aiming to release it within 2022, but no defined date yet.

Remember to [b]Follow[/b] and [b]Wishlist[/b] Chessarama to be one of the firsts to know. 😉


[h2]Will Chessarama feature a Creative Mode to players create their own levels?[/h2]

Yes: this is one of the main features of Chessarama.
We want you to create puzzles and challenge your friends to solve them!


[h2]How many original games will be in it?[/h2]

We're working to provide the most content we can. We're taking it one step at a time, but we already have ideas to new games. (We started to make the 4th one just recently!)

We would love to keep working on Chessarama for years to come, adding as much content we can! 💙


[h2]How many levels and puzzles it will have?[/h2]

Today we have more than 80 levels, but we're working on even more.
With the Creative Mode, we're expecting to see thousands of community-created levels available in the game! 😁


[h2]Will it be amazing?[/h2]

Very amazing, you bet. 😉


[h2]Can I play the Demo?[/h2]

Yes: it's available [b]NOW[/b] on Steam.
Visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/]Chessarama's store page[/url] and play it now!


[b]Don't forget to [u]Wishlist it and Follow the game[/u] to be notified when the final version Chessarama's release:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1831830/Chessarama/
